krema-somatos.description_en: A lightweight, fast-absorbing body lotion that hydrates and leaves the skin soft and protected. Formulated with organic honey, propolis, royal jelly, and beeswax. Suitable for daily use and all skin types.

ydromelo-valentine-gift-box.description_en: What is Mead? Mead is an alcoholic beverage made by fermenting honey with water and yeast. The type of honey used, as well as the addition of fruits, spices, and herbs, results in a wide variety of flavours and styles. The fermentation process can take anywhere from a few weeks to a few months, depending on the desired outcome.

meli-me-foyntoykia.description_en: The Honey and Hazelnuts spread is part of the new product line of “Oros Machaira,” “Premium Blends.” It combines the wonderful taste and beneficial properties of authentic Cypriot honey “Oros Machaira” with the nutritional benefits of hazelnuts. This delightful combination is rich in nutrients.

meli-me-fistikia.description_en: The Honey and Peanuts spread is part of the new product line of “Oros Machaira,” “Premium Blends”. It combines the delightful taste and beneficial properties of authentic Cypriot honey “Oros Machaira” with the nutritional benefits of peanuts. This delightful blend is a true superfood, rich in nutrients.

meli-me-gyri.description_en: The Honey and Bee Pollen spread is part of the new product line of “Oros Machaira”, “Premium Blends”. It combines the delightful, rich taste and unique beneficial properties of authentic Cypriot honey “Oros Machaira” with the exceptional nutritional benefits of bee pollen, creating a superfood rich in nutrients.

meli-me-charoypi-kai-foyntoykia.description_en: The Honey, Carob, and Hazelnuts spread is part of the new product line of “Oros Machaira,” “Premium Blends”. It combines the exquisite taste and beneficial properties of authentic Cypriot honey “Oros Machaira” with the nutritional benefits of carob and hazelnuts. kiraloifi-gia-entrives-sto-stithos-kai-m.description_en: A beeswax balm with a bright, invigorating aroma of essential oils. Massage it gently into the chest, neck or shoulders; the organic beeswax leaves a soft, protective layer on the skin.

kiraloifi-gia-kyttaritida.description_en:
Target cellulite with our expertly crafted Beeswax Cellulite Balm. This powerful natural formula is designed to improve your skin’s texture and tone, promote better circulation, and reduce the appearance of dimpled skin.

With consistent application, unveil a firmer, more supple skin profile, as you harness the benefits of nature to redefine your contours. Apply in circular motions to affected areas and embrace the journey to smoother skin.

meigma-melioy-gyris-kai-vasilikoy-poltoy.description_en: Nature’s Perfect Foods combined! This is a blend of the treasures of the hive: honey, royal jelly and pollen — three foods with a long tradition in the human diet. Royal jelly, the food of the queen, and our fresh pollen are combined with our pure honey in a blend with a rich taste and a velvety texture.

ydromelo.description_en: What is Mead? Mead is an alcoholic beverage made by fermenting honey with water and yeast. The type of honey used, as well as the addition of fruits, spices, and herbs, results in a wide variety of flavours and styles. The fermentation process can take anywhere from a few weeks to a few months, depending on the desired outcome.

gyri-oros-machaira.description_en: Oros Machaira pollen is collected from our own hives, is placed on the market fresh and is not processed at all. A gift from our bees to you.

vasilikos-poltos-oros-machaira.description_en:
Like pollen and honey, royal jelly is a real natural treasure made by bees, with the difference being that it is made exclusively to feed the queen! It is the par excellence food for royalty, used to give the queen enough energy to grow rapidly and to produce thousands of eggs every day.

Royal jelly has been used by people since antiquity. Our royal jelly is produced by our bee-keepers and is placed on the market fresh.

kirithra-oros-machaira.description_en:
Oros Machaira honeycomb is yet another gift from bees to us. By eating honeycomb you’re eating honey in the way bees prefer it.

At the same time, you’re getting all the nutritional properties not just of honey but also of beeswax. Honeycomb is an ideal choice when you crave something sweet.

By eating honeycomb, you satisfy your need for something sweet while at the same time offering your body a treasure trove of nutrients. Oros Machaira Honeycomb comes from the same bees Oros Machaira honey comes from and is cut and marketed in convenient packaging to allow you to enjoy it with ease.

vamma-propolis-oros-machaira.description_en: Propolis tincture is an alcohol solution made of alcohol and propolis. Propolis is the resinous substance bees use to seal and protect their hive, and people have used it since antiquity. Oros Machaira Propolis Tincture is prepared at our lab using alcohol and propolis taken straight from our bee-keepers’ honeybees.

meli-antheon-oros-machaira.description_en: Cyprus’s rich flora allows us to produce a rich and unique blossom honey. Blossom honey primarily consists of nectar from orange blossom, wild lavender, myrtle, germander, and other wild plants from Cyprus.

avrasto-meli-antheon-oros-machaira.description_en: Honey is considered to be “unheated” when it comes straight from the honeycomb without any processing and is sold to consumers just as the bees make it. Unlike honey which undergoes heat treatment and filtering, raw honey retains all its yeasts and pollen grains, which are what give it its high nutritional value.

thymarisio-meli-oros-machaira.description_en: Oros Machaira thyme honey is strongly aromatic, with a deep, savoury character rather than a purely sweet one. Widely regarded as the finest honey Cyprus produces.

melissokeri.description_en:
Pure beeswax is one of the many bee products. The bees use it to store their honey in.

Beeswax can be used by people in a variety of home-made cosmetics. You can make hand creams, lotions, lip balm, hair products and many other natural, cost-effective cosmetics.

It has soothing and emollient properties and when used on the skin it keeps it moisturised. You get the chance to buy pure, organic beeswax and get it delivered anywhere in Cyprus.
